description: List every published EvalGate documentation page. Use it to browse the catalog when you do not have a search term or slug. Returns each page's slug, title, URL and summary; pass limit/cursor to page through results, or omit both for the whole catalog.

cursor.description: Continuation cursor from the previous page's nextCursor.

limit.description: Maximum documents per page; defaults to 25 when paginating.

name: docs_list
